lessons.title: 2: Why Program?
lessons.name: Why Program?
lessons.description: We learn why one might want to learn to program, and look at the basic issues with learning to program.

videos.title: What happens when the CPU cooler is removed?

lessons.title: 3: Variables, expressions and statements
lessons.name: Variables, expressions and statements
lessons.description: We learn how to make variables and store data in those variables.

lessons.title: 4: Conditional Execution
lessons.name: Conditional Execution
lessons.description: We look at how Python executes some statements and skips others.

lessons.title: 5: Functions
lessons.name: Functions
lessons.description: Take a brief look at how Python implements the 'store and use later' programming pattern.

lessons.title: 6: Loops and Iterations
lessons.name: Loops and Iterations
lessons.description: We look at how Python repeats statements using looping structures.

lessons.title: 7: Strings
lessons.name: Strings
lessons.description: We look at how Python stores and manipulates textual data using string variables and functions.

lessons.title: 8: Files
lessons.name: Files
lessons.description: We learn how to open data files on your computer and read through the files using Python.

lessons.title: 9: Lists
lessons.name: Lists
lessons.description: We look at Python's simplest data structure - the list. Lists can store more than one item in a variable.

videos.title: Lists, Files and the Guardian Pattern

lessons.title: 10: Dictionaries
lessons.name: Dictionaries
lessons.description: The dictionary data structures allows us to store multiple values in an object and look up the values by their key.

videos.title: Counting Word Frequency using a Dictionary

lessons.title: 11: Tuples
lessons.name: Tuples
lessons.description: The tuple is a Python data structure that is like a simple and efficient list.

lessons.title: 12: Regular Expressions
lessons.name: Regular Expressions
lessons.description: Regular Expressions allow us to search for patterns in strings and extract data from strings using the regular expression programming language.

lessons.title: 13: Network Programming
lessons.name: Network Programming
lessons.description: We take a quick look at how data moves across the network using the HyperText Transport Protocol (HTTP) and how we write programs to read data across the network.

references.title: Characters, Symbols and the Unicode Miracle - Computerphile

lessons.title: 14: Using Web Services
lessons.name: Using Web Services
lessons.description: Web services allow a program to access data available in a different server.

lessons.title: 15: Object-Oriented Programming
lessons.name: Object-Oriented Programming
lessons.description: We do a quick look at how Python supports the Object-Oriented programming pattern.

lessons.title: 16: Databases
lessons.name: Databases
lessons.description: Databases give us very fast random access to large amounts of data. There is a lot of material in this chapter as we learn the Structured Query Language (SQL).

lessons.title: 17: Data Visualization
lessons.name: Data Visualization
lessons.description: In this section, we learn to scrape data from the network, store the data in a database and then read the data from the database to produce in in-browser visualization of the data.
